newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - SIIMANN GETS PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - SIIMANN GETS PARLIAMENTARY APPROVAL.

text.p: The Estonian parliament voted on Wednesday to grant Mart Siimann the authority to form a new government. Of the 90 members present in the 101 member house, 72 voted for Siimann, 13 against, 3 did not vote and 2 abstained.
Siimann now has seven days to form a government with 15 ministers, including himself. Then he will come back to the parliament for final approval of his cabinet.
